content:
About Us  


Supio is a trusted AI platform purpose-built for law firms, reshaping how data drives impactful outcomes. Our innovative approach blends technology with deep legal expertise, making us a leader in our field. We go beyond surface-level AI to deeply understand our customers’ daily needs, empowering law firms with unparalleled data insights. Supio delivers human-level, accurate analysis of complex data and legal records, quickly and efficiently bringing critical insights when they matter most. Trusted by top litigation lawyers, our platform has supported over $1 billion in settlements.

Headquartered in Seattle with an office in San Francisco, we raised $60M Series B in April 2025 led by Sapphire Ventures with Mayfield and Thomson Reuters Ventures, bringing total funding to $91M. We're scaling rapidly and looking for exceptional talent to join us in this next phase of growth.

​​We're looking for passionate team members who are motivated by our mission and ready to help us achieve it.


What we're looking for


We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to join our Product Team at Supio in either Seattle or San Francisco. You have a deep understanding of our domain and desire to delight our customers. You will oversee the entire product development lifecycle, from strategy and roadmap creation to execution and launch, eventually managing and mentoring a team of product managers, while also collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to ensure product success. You'll report directly to the Chief Product Officer. 

What you'll do


  • Product Vision and Strategy: You'll define the long-term vision and strategy for a product area, ensuring it aligns with our overall goals.
  • Roadmap Development: You'll create and maintain the product roadmap, prioritizing features and ensuring they are aligned with market needs and business objectives.
  • Market Research and Analysis: You'll conduct market research to understand customer needs, identify opportunities, and validate product ideas.
  • Product Backlog Management:You'll manage the product backlog, ensuring it is prioritized and contains the necessary information for our development teams.
  • Stakeholder Management: You'll work closely with stakeholders, including engineering, marketing, sales, and executives, to ensure everyone is aligned and informed
  • Product Development Process: You'll oversee the product development process, ensuring our products are developed and launched on time and within budget.
  • Launch Planning and post-launch analysis: Plan and execute product launches, ensuring a smooth and successful launch. Analyze product performance after launch, identifying areas for improvement and making data-driven decisions


Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Business Administration, or related field; or equivalent experience in software engineering.
  • 10+ years of experience in product management or technical leadership in B2B environments, with a strong preference for experience in AI.
  • Proven ability to use data and analytics to inform decision-making and improve product features.
  • Skilled in managing cross-functional teams and driving projects to successful completion.
  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to convey complex ideas effectively.


Compensation
As an early-stage startup, we offer a competitive compensation package that includes base salary, meaningful equity, and benefits. Equity grants are designed to ensure employees share in the long-term success and upside of the company.

Base Salary: $200,000 - $250,000 annually

Actual compensation may vary outside of these ranges based on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, experience, and geographic location.

Compensation & Benefits
  • 💰 Competitive Salary + Meaningful Equity
  • 💹 401(k)
  • ⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
  • 🏝 Flexible Time Off + Holidays
  • 🧑‍💻 High-autonomy work environment, every Tuesday is a Remote Work Day
  • 🥗 DoorDash subsidies for breakfast and dinner; Daily lunch options
  • 🧋 Boba Wednesdays
  • 🚃 Monthly commuter subsidies and pre-tax parking contribution
  • 🚀 Team gatherings and offsites

E-Verify Participation Notice  

Supio participates in E-Verify, an employment authorization program through the U.S. Department of Homeland Security and the Social Security Administration. 

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement 

Supio is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

  • Excellent organizational skills with a keen eye for detail. 
  • Strong written and verbal communication abilities. 
  • Proficiency in using CRM and sales tools to manage pipelines and track performance. 
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented, with a collaborative mindset.

  • Demonstrated passion for Supio’s mission, with a strong understanding of AI and its potential to revolutionize knowledge work.

Nice to Haves

  • Previous startup experience

content:
About Us  


Supio is a trusted AI platform purpose-built for law firms, reshaping how data drives impactful outcomes. Our innovative approach blends technology with deep legal expertise, making us a leader in our field. We go beyond surface-level AI to deeply understand our customers’ daily needs, empowering law firms with unparalleled data insights. Supio delivers human-level, accurate analysis of complex data and legal records, quickly and efficiently bringing critical insights when they matter most. Trusted by top litigation lawyers, our platform has supported over $1 billion in settlements.

Headquartered in Seattle with an office in San Francisco, we raised $60M Series B in April 2025 led by Sapphire Ventures with Mayfield and Thomson Reuters Ventures, bringing total funding to $91M. We're scaling rapidly and looking for exceptional talent to join us in this next phase of growth.

​​We're looking for passionate team members who are motivated by our mission and ready to help us achieve it.


Who we’re looking for


We’re looking for a Data Engineer who brings intellectual curiosity and genuine drive to understand the business and product — not just the data. This isn’t a role for someone who waits for requirements; it’s for an independent thinker who seeks out cross-functional peers for problems worth solving and then builds the systems to solve them. You’ll work closely with senior engineering and leadership across the company, sitting at the intersection of data infrastructure, AI, and business strategy. If you’re energized by building from the ground up and making ambiguous problems concrete, this is the role for you.

What you’ll do


  • Establish Data Foundations: Build the data infrastructure needed to deeply understand agent behavior, usage patterns, and performance—turning raw signals into actionable intelligence that informs product and business decisions.
  • Build Agent Evaluation Infrastructure: Design and implement structured evaluation frameworks for Supio’s AI agents, creating the measurement systems that enable continuous improvement of our core product.
  • Analyze User Behavior: Investigate how customers interact with Supio’s platform, comparing natural language input patterns against traditional click-based behavior to surface insights that drive product strategy.
  • Solve High-Impact Business Problems: Identify and build systems that address Supio’s most critical data challenges, driving outcomes that matter to the business rather than producing routine reports.
  • Shape Data Strategy: Partner with senior engineering and leadership to define where data creates the most leverage, elevating the function beyond basic analytics toward real business impact.

Qualifications


  • Experience: 4+ years in data engineering or data science, with a track record of owning and delivering complex data projects end-to-end as an individual contributor.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency with modern data engineering and data science stacks and tools; hands-on experience with data lakes, read replicas, and distributed data systems.
  • Business Acumen: Drive and demonstrate ability to deeply understand business context and product goals—you seek out the ‘why’ before building the ‘what.’
  • Problem Formulation: Creative problem solver who translates ambiguous business questions into well-scoped data problems with measurable outcomes.
  • Independent Execution: Proven track record driving projects from initial scoping through delivery without requiring close direction; you own outcomes, not just tasks.
  • Communication: Strong ability to communicate technical concepts and findings to non-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership.
  • Collaboration: Comfortable working across engineering, product, and leadership teams in a fast-moving startup environment.
  • Familiarity with LLMs, AI agents, or evaluation frameworks for generative AI systems.

You’re a strong fit if you 


  • Founding data engineer or early data team experience at a high-growth startup.
  • Background that spans product management and data engineering, with the ability to bridge both worlds.
  • Exposure to legal tech or other complex verticals.

Compensation


As an early-stage startup, we offer a competitive compensation package that includes base salary, meaningful equity, and benefits. Equity grants are designed to ensure employees share in the long-term success and upside of the company.

Base Salary by Location
Seattle, WA: $185,000 - $220,000 annually
San Francisco, CA: $185,000 - $220,000 annually

Actual compensation may vary outside of these ranges based on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, experience, and geographic location.


Compensation & Benefits
  • 💰 Competitive Salary + Meaningful Equity
  • 💹 401(k)
  • ⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
  • 🏝 Flexible Time Off + Holidays
  • 🧑‍💻 High-autonomy work environment, every Tuesday is a Remote Work Day
  • 🥗 DoorDash subsidies for breakfast and dinner; Daily lunch options
  • 🧋 Boba Wednesdays
  • 🚃 Monthly commuter subsidies and pre-tax parking contribution
  • 🚀 Team gatherings and offsites

E-Verify Participation Notice  

Supio participates in E-Verify, an employment authorization program through the U.S. Department of Homeland Security and the Social Security Administration. 

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement 

Supio is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

About Us  


Supio is a trusted AI platform purpose-built for law firms, reshaping how data drives impactful outcomes. Our innovative approach blends technology with deep legal expertise, making us a leader in our field. We go beyond surface-level AI to deeply understand our customers’ daily needs, empowering law firms with unparalleled data insights. Supio delivers human-level, accurate analysis of complex data and legal records, quickly and efficiently bringing critical insights when they matter most. Trusted by top litigation lawyers, our platform has supported over $1 billion in settlements.

Headquartered in Seattle with an office in San Francisco, we raised $60M Series B in April 2025 led by Sapphire Ventures with Mayfield and Thomson Reuters Ventures, bringing total funding to $91M. We're scaling rapidly and looking for exceptional talent to join us in this next phase of growth.

​​We're looking for passionate team members who are motivated by our mission and ready to help us achieve it.


Who Are We Looking to Add to Our Team?

We are seeking an Enterprise Account Executive to develop our relationships within the legal community further in the New York market. This position will grow our product sales markets and be a major contributor to building our business. Our Account Executive role will positively impact those seeking a challenging yet rewarding career in sales.  

Key Responsibilities

  • Own your sales cycle and meet or exceed revenue targets. 
  • Feel driven to prospect, cold call, and close new business opportunities. 
  • Meet prospects in person, build relationships, and showcase Supio’s platform as a game-changer for legal professionals. 
  • Attend industry conferences, trade shows, and events to connect with law firm decision-makers, generate leads, and close deals. 
  • Work closely with marketing, product, and customer success teams to align strategies and provide feedback on client needs. 
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date data in the CRM, ensuring transparency and precision in pipeline tracking and forecasting. 

Qualifications

  • Proven track record of managing end-to-end sales processes  
  • History of consistently meeting or exceeding sales quotas and driving revenue growth. 
  • Excellent organizational skills with a keen eye for detail. 
  • Strong written and verbal communication abilities. 
  • Proficiency in using CRM and sales tools to manage pipelines and track performance. 
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented, with a collaborative mindset. 
  • Team player with a competitive edge who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. 
  • Demonstrated passion for Supio’s mission, with a strong understanding of AI and its potential to revolutionize knowledge work. 
  • Interest in the legal profession and a desire to help lawyers do their jobs better and more efficiently.

  • Personal injury industry experience strongly preferred

  • Interest in AI

Who we're looking for


We're hiring senior/staff, product-minded full-stack engineers to build Supio's agentic platform — applied AI at the core, in high-stakes, real-world legal workflows. You build product end-to-end in TypeScript across the stack, from the interfaces customers touch to the services behind them. You have hands-on experience shipping LLM/AI systems in production, you're fluent using coding agents in your daily workflow, and you operate with real autonomy. You've thrived in a startup environment and you're excited to build greenfield.

What you'll build

(scope depends on team placement)
  • Agentic platform capabilities spanning voice calling & transcription, medical/financial records extraction, and legal document drafting
  • The agent runtime — prompt/tool architecture, skill and prompt management, and cost/performance optimization
  • The core full-stack application customers work in every day
  • Production LLM-driven features, plus the evaluation, tooling, and monitoring that keep them accurate and observable at scale

You won't just ship features — you'll shape the architecture and technical direction of a fast-evolving, AI-native platform, with senior autonomy and end-to-end ownership.

What you'll bring (must-haves)

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • True full-stack depth. You own product end-to-end, front to back. This isn't a front-end or backend specialist role; you're comfortable across the whole stack (React/TypeScript on the front end and modern backend services, APIs, and data pipelines).
  • Strong product sense. You build customer-facing product and translate real user needs into technical solutions
  • Hands-on applied AI/LLM systems experience. You've built real systems end-to-end and can speak to what you owned and what broke in production
  • Fluency with coding agents as part of how you build
  • Startup background. Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and greenfield
  • Autonomy and ownership. Able to meet in-office/hybrid expectations in Seattle or San Francisco

Nice to have

  • Prior experience at AI-native companies
  • Formal ML background (optional — practical AI fluency matters more than credentials)

Compensation

Competitive package of base salary, meaningful equity, and benefits.

Base Salary: $200,000–$255,000 annually

Actual compensation depends on qualifications, skills, experience, and location.

content:
About Us  


Supio is a trusted AI platform purpose-built for law firms, reshaping how data drives impactful outcomes. Our innovative approach blends technology with deep legal expertise, making us a leader in our field. We go beyond surface-level AI to deeply understand our customers’ daily needs, empowering law firms with unparalleled data insights. Supio delivers human-level, accurate analysis of complex data and legal records, quickly and efficiently bringing critical insights when they matter most. Trusted by top litigation lawyers, our platform has supported over $1 billion in settlements.

Headquartered in Seattle with an office in San Francisco, we raised $60M Series B in April 2025 led by Sapphire Ventures with Mayfield and Thomson Reuters Ventures, bringing total funding to $91M. We're scaling rapidly and looking for exceptional talent to join us in this next phase of growth.

​​We're looking for passionate team members who are motivated by our mission and ready to help us achieve it.


Who We're Looking For


We’re looking for a hands-on, high-agency Site Reliability Engineer to help shape and scale the reliability layer of our stack. You'll own the release pipeline end-to-end — managing daily releases, weekly deploys, and hotfixes — while also automating infrastructure, monitoring systems, and GitHub workflows. This is a software engineering role, deeply embedded in DevOps culture, with significant autonomy and direct impact on the pace and safety of our shipping process.
You’ll work closely with engineers, product leads, and company leadership to ensure uptime, speed, and confidence in every deploy.

What You’ll Do


  • Own Deployments: Lead our release and deployment process — from daily rollouts to weekly deploys and hotfix coordination. Build safe, repeatable, and observable workflows.
  • GitHub Operations: Manage GitHub branching strategies, pull request flows, merge policies, and GitHub Actions. Set and enforce collaboration standards for the engineering team.
  • Infrastructure & Monitoring: Build and maintain resilient AWS-based infrastructure. Set up and manage observability tools (logs, metrics, traces), configure alarms, and be the first responder for incidents. Triage, escalate, or resolve based on impact.
  • Automation & Internal Tooling: Write scripts, services, and automations that reduce friction and improve deployment confidence. Using AI tools to generate code is encouraged and expected — you'll be comfortable guiding, adapting, and integrating AI-assisted outputs into production workflows.
  • Software Development: You’ll contribute code when needed — whether that’s building internal tools, improving system reliability, or unblocking a deploy. This is not a sprint-based role, but strong software fundamentals are key to success.
  • Support Global Teams: Work off-hours as needed to unblock offshore teams and maintain deployment velocity across time zones.

You’re a Great Fit If You


  • Have 3–6+ years in SRE, DevOps, or infrastructure roles with production ownership.
  • Started your career in software development — and still enjoy writing code.
  • Are fluent in or at least familiar with Bash, Python, TypeScript, and Postgres SQL.
  • Are a confident AWS operator and know your way around EC2, Lambda, RDS, IAM, and VPCs.
  • Have strong experience with GitHub workflows, including GitHub Actions and release automation.
  • Are comfortable using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) to generate code — and have the skill to audit and adapt that code to meet production standards.
  • Are familiar with CI/CD principles and enjoy owning the full deployment lifecycle.
  • Are comfortable being on-call and understand how to design systems for both speed and safety.
  • Can operate with a high level of autonomy in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.

Salary

As an early-stage startup, we offer a competitive compensation package that includes base salary, meaningful equity, and benefits. Equity grants are designed to ensure employees share in the long-term success and upside of the company.

Base Salary: $170,000 – $220,000 annually

Actual compensation will be determined based on a candidate's qualifications, skills, experience, and geographic location.

Compensation & Benefits
  • 💰 Competitive Salary + Meaningful Equity
  • 💹 401(k)
  • ⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
  • 🏝 Flexible Time Off + Holidays
  • 🧑‍💻 High-autonomy work environment, every Tuesday is a Remote Work Day
  • 🥗 DoorDash subsidies for breakfast and dinner; Daily lunch options
  • 🧋 Boba Wednesdays
  • 🚃 Monthly commuter subsidies and pre-tax parking contribution
  • 🚀 Team gatherings and offsites
